personality_one_liner: A clean, trustworthy, and content-led product discovery experience using native iOS rhythms.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding. Group related elements cleanly with plenty of whitespace. Sticky actions get safe-area padding at bottom.

do's: Use glass effect for the sticky 'Filter & Sort' header over scrolling lists.
Use glass for sticky bottom CTAs on the product details page.
dont's: Don't use glass on individual list rows or product cards.
Don't use glass on form inputs.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Quick entry point with prominent search and featured deals.

states.empty: No deals right now, check back later.
states.error: Failed to load deals. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Sticky header with search bar (navigates to SearchResults). Below header: horizontal scroll of categories/filters. Then a grid or list of 'Trending Deals' highlighting product name, best price, and distance.

screens.name: SearchResults
screens.purpose: Displays product listings matching user criteria with accessible filters.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No products found in this area.' + 'Clear filters' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load products. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with a 'Filter & Sort' trigger and applied filter chips. The list below contains product cards showing the best available price, distance of nearest seller, and total sellers.

screens.name: ProductDetail
screens.purpose: Aggregates all sellers for a single product so user can compare.

states.empty: Not applicable once product is loaded.
states.error: Failed to load seller deals. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Top half: Product image hero and summary (title, lowest price). Bottom half: A distinct list of sellers. Each seller row shows store name, price, distance, and stock. Bottom of screen: Sticky primary CTA over a glass surface ('View Best Deal').

sneaker_3.alt: gray and white new balance shoe

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the MVP using `stack_only` navigation: Home -> SearchResults -> ProductDetail.

Follow '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality guidelines: use Geist typography (or similar modern sans-serif fallback if Geist is unavailable in Expo, like Plus Jakarta Sans), and maintain generous padding.
Implement a Bottom Sheet using @gorhom/bottom-sheet for the 'Filter & Sort' controls on the SearchResults page.
Make sure the ProductDetail screen has a sticky bottom CTA area using glassmorphism (or solid surfaceSecondary fallback for android) pointing to the best deal.
Ensure seller comparison rows clearly separate price, distance, and stock status using typography hierarchy.
Do not use indigo, violet, blue, or purple in any of the UI elements. Stick to the Sage Green brand and neutrals.
No auth required. Hardcode mock data for products and sellers to demonstrate functionality.
